Look Ma! No Derailleurs! - I.G.H. Bikes from Rodriguez
There's a reason that Rodriguez is the number 1 Rohloff builder in the United States. It's because we know Rohloff customers don't want to compromise on comfort, features, or quality. We build your bike the way you want it. Whether it's a 650b gravel bike with disc brakes, a loaded touring bike, or a daily commuter, we've built it with Rohloff (or Alfine).
• Choose your wheels (26", 650b or 700c)
• Most experienced U.S. Rohloff builder
• Hand crafted in Seattle for your unique needs
• Wide gearing range and Rohloff reliability!
• No compromise on comfort - It's just your size!
• Models for everyone - road or gravel
• Your bike, your way, at a great value!
Full Rohloff bike from $6,900
Durability, low maintenance, variety, Read More...
Instead of a bike with a Rohloff hub installed, think of a Rodriguez Makeshift™ as a Rohloff Speedhub with a bike built around it. Our head frame builder, Todd, worked for the Rohloff company in Germany in the early 2000's and has special insight into optimizing the design for bikes using a Rohloff Speedhub. We've developed and manufactured specific braze-on fittings, dropouts, and other unique exclusive features (like our stem mounted shifter doohickey) that make our Rohloff equipped bicycles something special. Our customers find our bikes easier to use and travel with. Just like all Rodriguez bicycles, the Makeshift™ series is guaranteed to fit comfortably.
At Rodriguez Bicycles, we know Rohloff and IGH equipped bikes. We've built hundreds of them at this point. Over the last several years, our Makeshift™ line of custom Rodriguez bicycles has become a standard of sorts in the industry, and one of our better selling models.
A lot of Rodriguez Makeshift™ customers select the travel upgrade for ease of taking their bike on vacation with them.

All Rodriguez Rohloff and IGH equipped bikes are available in 20 production sizes as well as custom sizing for just $200 extra. Paint Options. Decal Options:
With a Rodriguez, you can get a custom look for less. All Rodriguez bicycles come in your choice of 16 standard paint colors or for a few $$ extra you can choose from dozens of our snazzy colors in stock. We have four different styles of decals to choose from in . If you have a special paint design in mind, just let us know the design, and we'll quote it for you.
WARNING! Not all Rohloff bikes are the same
Most builders who make Rohloff bikes use Rohloff's 'click box' design for shifting. While this makes the bicycle easier to manufacture, it has caused problems for some of our Rohloff customers. At Rodriguez, we go the extra mile and build some custom braze-ons to make your life easier. If you're interested in reading about those differences, click here
